verdict.line: You lose if you throw Q into an up Counter Strike or stand in extended autos against his level-6 all-in; you win almost every trade once Jax's E is down and your Judgment cooldown starts resetting fast.

brief.thesis: Jax's entire kit is built to dodge or punish Garen's auto-attack-reliant trade pattern: Counter Strike (E) eats the auto that carries Decisive Strike's silence, and Empower (W) turns his counter-trade into real damage. Garen wins this lane (54.4% over 5532 games) by refusing to feed Q into an up Counter Strike and instead trading only when Jax's E and Leap Strike (Q) are both down, letting Perseverance's passive regen and Judgment's falling cooldown grind him out.

theirWindow.what: Do not commit Decisive Strike (Q) or stand in prolonged autos here — Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks and then stuns and damages you, eating the exact attack that carries your Q silence. Back off and auto-poke with Judgment (E) range instead.

yourWindow.when: his Counter Strike (E) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and commit Decisive Strike (Q) for the move-speed burst and silence, then chain Judgment (E) spins and autos — he has no basic-attack dodge or stun available to interrupt the trade.

start.why: Flat damage reduction and the health-regen-on-hit blunt Jax's empowered autos and stack directly with Perseverance's passive sustain — the exact combination OP.GG flags as your win condition. Picked in 47.6% of games at 54.7% WR.

boots.why: The attack speed feeds Garen's auto-attack-and-Judgment trade loop directly; 75.7% pick rate and the highest win rate of any boots option (55.8%).

core.why: Its active slow is how you catch Jax after he disengages with Leap Strike, and the empowered next-attack mirrors his own Empower, so you're no longer the only one with a burst auto.
More attack speed to spam Judgment's falling cooldown and the move speed to stick to Jax when he tries to kite with Leap Strike resets.
Grievous Wounds cuts into the bonus health Jax's passive and lifesteal items grant him, which matters since this exact path hits 57.9% WR over 1457 games.

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended E (Judgment) spins and auto trades stack Conqueror's adaptive force fast, and it synergizes with Perseverance's regen rather than requiring you to burst and leave, which fits the grind-him-out trade pattern this matchup rewards. Run on this page at 54.4% WR, 47.2% pick.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 97% of games at 55% WR, and the true damage burst is what converts Garen's already-measured solo-kill advantage into an actual kill before Jax can disengage with Leap Strike.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike before engaging
playing.detail: Feint an auto outside his 300-range Counter Strike until it's used or he lets it expire, then step in for Decisive Strike (Q) and chain Judgment (E).

playing.title: Never Q into an up Counter Strike
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup: Counter Strike dodges the auto-attack that carries your Q silence, so holding Q until his E is down is the single highest-leverage habit here.

playing.title: Trade on cooldowns, not a clock
playing.detail: Track Jax's Leap Strike and Counter Strike cooldowns rather than lane timers — whenever both are down, that's your window to walk up and spin Judgment.

playing.title: Reset between trades for passive regen
playing.detail: Back off after short trades to let Perseverance tick; the longer the lane goes without you taking damage, the more your health regen advantage compounds.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 all-in
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and ramps attack speed on every strike, so a sustained 1v1 at level 6 rewards whoever lands first — use Decisive Strike's silence to deny his empowered third hit.

playing.title: Ramp poke once Judgment nears max
playing.detail: By levels 9-12 Judgment's cooldown drops into single digits, letting you poke far more often than his Leap Strike cooldown can keep pace with.

playing.title: Close low-health windows with R immediately
playing.detail: Demacian Justice's execute threat punishes hesitation, so finish any low-health window right away rather than letting Jax disengage with Leap Strike.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, item paths, rune pages, and skill order above are measured from live OP.GG match data on the current patch; the trade-pattern reasoning — when to hold Q, when Judgment's cooldown flips the lane, how the level 6 all-in resolves — is our own tactical read built to match those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Jax block [Q] by activating Counter Strike (E). Attack him whenever your skills come off cooldown and activate [P] to increase your sustain to gain the upper hand.
